'''Green Tea''' is a drinkable [[Artisan Goods|Artisan Good]] made with the [[Keg]] using [[Tea Leaves]], taking 3 hours.

When consumed, it grants the player +30 [[Energy|Max Energy]] and +0.5 [[Speed]] for 4m 12s. As a drink, its [[Buffs|buff]] stacks with any food buffs (including Max Energy), but replaces any other drink buffs (''i.e.,'' from [[Coffee]], [[Ginger Ale]] or [[Triple Shot Espresso]]).

It is sold by [[Caroline]] during the [[Desert Festival]] for {{Price|10|Calico}} [[Calico Egg]]s.

==Bundles==
Green Tea is one of the options for the {{bundle|brewers||y}}.

==Tailoring==
Green Tea is used in the spool of the [[2 Willow Lane#Sewing Machine|Sewing Machine]] to create the [[File:Shirt287.png|24px]] [[Tailoring|Tea Shirt]]. It can be used in [[dyeing]], serving as a green dye at the dye pots, located in [[Emily]]'s and [[Haley]]'s house, [[2 Willow Lane]].

==Quests==
One Green Tea may be requested by [[Blobfish]] or [[Octopus]] in [[Fish Pond#Quests|Fish Pond quests]].
